correctness.rationale: Both exact rational means follow from the complete three-orbit first-jump Dirichlet equations for the product chain, with absorption a.s. even at zero trap rate. Algebra gives exact slowdown roots and clock comparison; derivative numerator quartics are strictly decreasing on positive ratio for every \(m\ge 2\), guaranteeing unique global maxima. Positive polynomial upper-bound certificates and \(x=m^{-1/2}\) matching lower asymptotics prove the distinct sharp maximum growth. Independently constructed full labeled-state rational generators passed 40 formula evaluations and 880 first-step equations; finite checks are not substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: Per-edge clocks and degree-normalized departure clocks are canonical alternatives for stochastic particle motion on hub-and-spoke structures. Quantifying how both conventions respond to mobile traps at fixed leaf hopping clock yields exact phase boundaries and a striking sharp disparity: worst case delay scales as \(m/2\) in one model but tends to 2 in the other. This is a motivated nonregular-network sensitivity classification that excludes arbitrary parameter slicing; its physically meaningful observable is mean encounter time.
